findings.description: Eligibility is limited to rural households for the deprivation criteria, but the draft lacks a predicate capturing rural residency.
findings.source_quote: AB PM-JAY targets rural deprived families and identified occupational categories of urban workers, identified using the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 data.
